correctness.rationale: On one-cell homogeneous cold VA-II data e≠0, C0>0, R²=C0+e²/2, y=h²e²/(8R²), midpoint equations yield v=he/(1+y), r=R(1−y)/(1+y), and E=e−hv/2 via winding-aware integrated current. The second Riccati stage has exact denominator (1−3y)/(1−y), with genuine positive-coefficient pole at y=1/3, so connected positive-r step interval 0<h<sqrt(8/3)R/|e|. Exact algebra verified modified energy v²/2+r²=R², positive physical-energy excess C0e²h⁴/[8R²(1+y)²], and r*g−E=4ey²/[(1+y)(1−3y)]. This depends on the source VA-II stage interpretation and admissibility of a nonzero constant Gauss-law harmonic field, not on the optional zero-mean Poisson initialization; full primary technical text was not independently accessible.
